common.pinError: Enter a 6-digit PIN code that does not start with 0.
common.results: {count, plural, =0 {No providers} one {# provider} other {# providers}}
common.resultsIn: {count, plural, =0 {No providers} one {# provider} other {# providers}} serving PIN {pin}
common.emptyTitle: No providers serve this PIN yet
common.emptyBody: Try another PIN or show all providers. Only providers who serve an area are listed for it.
common.manual: The provider accepts or declines each request by hand. Nothing is charged now.
common.notConnectedTitle: This service is not connected yet
common.notConnectedBody: Requests cannot be sent until the service is connected. No providers or prices are assumed.
common.missingBody: Pick a provider from the list to start a request.

form.noCoveredTitle: None of your saved addresses is in this area
form.noCoveredBody: Add an address from the doctor booking or your profile, or choose another provider.
form.noTimesTitle: No open times in the next 5 days
form.noTimesBody: Choose another provider or try again later.
form.noteHint: Up to {max} characters. Do not add phone numbers, ID numbers or card details.
form.priceNote: Set by the provider. The price is fixed when you send the request.
form.payAfter: Pay the provider after the service
form.onlineDisabled: Online payment is not available yet.
form.policy: Free to cancel up to 2 hours before the start. Sample policy for testing.
form.accept: I accept the price and the cancellation policy.
form.conflictBody: The time or price changed while you were filling this in. Check the details and send again.

errors.address: Choose an address in this provider's area.
errors.policyAccepted: Accept the price and the cancellation policy.
errors.note: Keep the note to 200 characters or fewer.

status.noReference: You get a reference number when the provider accepts.
status.priceNote: Fixed when you sent the request.
status.changesClosed: Cancelling closes 2 hours before the start. Contact support if you need help.
status.policySummary: Free to cancel up to 2 hours before the start. Sample policy for testing.

requested.title: Waiting for {name} to answer
requested.body: The provider reviews each request by hand. Their answer appears here. Use Check for updates to see it.

confirmed.title: {name} accepted your request
confirmed.body: Your request is confirmed. Pay the provider after the service.

declined.title: {name} could not take this request
declined.body: You have not been charged. Choose another provider or time.

completed.title: Service completed
completed.body: Thank you. Payment and records appear here once they are recorded.

expired.title: This request has closed
expired.body: The provider did not answer in time. You have not been charged.

lab.description: Choose a lab that serves your area. A collector comes to your address to take the sample.
lab.requestDescription: Choose tests and a collection time. The lab accepts or declines your request.

preparation.fasting_10h: Do not eat for 10 hours before. Water is fine.
preparation.morning_sample: Use the first urine of the morning.

lab.prepAck: I will follow the preparation shown for these tests.
lab.reportNote: Reports are released only by the lab's reviewer and then appear in your Records.

errors.preparationAcknowledged: Confirm you will follow the preparation.

lab.prepEmpty: Choose tests to see how to prepare.

care.description: Book one shift of non-clinical help at home from a caretaker or agency that serves your area.
care.requestDescription: Choose the help you need, the start time and the hours. The caretaker accepts or declines your request.
care.tasksHint: Choose everything that applies. Only help this provider offers is listed.
care.hoursHint: Between {min} and {max} hours, starting at the time you choose.
care.scopeBody: Caretakers help with daily living. They do not give medical treatment, injections or medicines, and they do not diagnose. For medical needs, book a doctor.
care.scopeAck: I understand caretakers give non-clinical help only.
care.recurring: Regular or repeating care plans are not available yet. Request one shift at a time.
care.recordNote: Caretakers do not write medical records.

errors.tasks: Choose at least one kind of help.
errors.scopeAcknowledged: Confirm you understand caretakers give non-clinical help only.

ambulance.description: Book a planned, non-emergency transfer, for example going home from hospital or to a planned appointment.
ambulance.requestDescription: Choose the vehicle, pickup, drop-off and time. The operator accepts or declines your request.
ambulance.emergencyBody: This page books scheduled, non-emergency transfers only. It cannot send an ambulance now. In an emergency, do not wait for a reply here.
ambulance.noTracking: No live tracking or arrival time is shown. The operator confirms the vehicle by hand.
ambulance.vehicleHint: Fares are fixed by the operator for transfers inside its area.
ambulance.destinationNameHint: For example, the hospital name. Do not add phone numbers.
ambulance.destinationArea: The drop-off must be in PIN {pins}.
ambulance.companion: Someone will travel with the patient
ambulance.notEmergency: I confirm this is a planned transfer, not an emergency.
ambulance.recordNote: A transfer does not create a medical record.

errors.vehicleType: Choose a vehicle that can carry the patient.
errors.destination: Enter the drop-off area, city and a 6-digit PIN in this operator's area.
errors.notEmergency: Confirm this is not an emergency. For emergencies call 112.
